messages.subject: Telemetry Capture History Errors
parts:
Hello, 

I am working to incorporate telemetry data with trapping data, and running into a few issues. I am fairly certain the two messages that I am receiving are related to each other, but I have struggled to find the solution. 


1) Problem one occurs as I create a telemetry capture history file with read.telemetry. I believe I have the dataframe formatted correctly with the right columns, but I am failing to see what capture history my telemetry CH is being compared to. After this message, there is still a telemetry CH that is produced and I am capable of running a basic model with that data alone as long as I provide the argument "verify = FALSE". Am I missing something simple here? 

> telemCH <- read.telemetry(data = telem)
Session 1 
Telemetry data (telemetryxy) do not match capture histories


2) The second problem is an error message as I try to combine the trapping and telemetry capture histories with addTelemetry. Both of these capture history files are the bare minimum - meaning they don't have any covariates. I am unsure what is causing this error as well. 

> combinedCH <- addTelemetry(bobwhiteCH, telemCH)
Error in `covariates<-`(`*tmp*`, value = list()) : 
  length of covariate does not match


Thank you for any help that can be offered! I have attached a subset of our trapping and telemetry files, trap history files, and r code for further inspection if needed. 

Regards, 
Nathan Wilhite

messages.author: 25e1136968577f39
messages.subject: Re: Telemetry Capture History Errors
parts:
Update:

The first error was due to my instinct to synchronize the dates of the telemetry and the trapping occasion - if a bird was tracked on October 10th, that was the 4th occasion during the trapping regimen, so I called it occasion 4 for the telemetry capture history. This left a whole bunch of zeroes for the telemetry capture history, which should not occur. I am not sure why I did this as it doesn't say to do so in any vignette. That said, it is fixed now. 

The second error with "addTelemetry" is still an issue that I have not resolved. The only workaround that I have been able to try is "MS.capthist" which allows me to bind the two capture histories. I may be using it in the wrong context, as the telemetry data that I have is not from multiple sessions, but I am running some basic models with the combined capture history to give it a whirl. 

Hope somebody in the future might find this useful! 

Nathan W.
